Backend: 12/12 tests pass (auth for owner+buyer, TEST_ prefix exclusion on /api/listings feed and /api/stories, verified-only gate on /api/marketplace/summary returns 403 for unverified & 401 for anon, core endpoints /threads, /transactions/mine, /members, /notifications, /profile/me all 200). Frontend: MarketHeader (data-testid market-header) now renders on EVERY logged-in page tested (/marketplace, /dashboard, /listing/{id}, /messages, /messages/{threadId}, /transactions, /members, /members/{id}, /profile, /verification, /sell) with real logo, mh-search, mh-sell-btn, mh-dashboard-btn, mh-profile-chip, mh-logout; the OLD header (.brand / nav-marketplace / app-links) count = 0 on every page checked. Listing detail rebuilt: message-btn opens real thread (/messages/{id}); no 'coming soon' text; video listing (Turnout Gear — Size L) shows <video data-testid=detail-video> with a navy 'FIRST UNIT' gold-text SVG poster — no black box; photo listings show real images. Filter rail works: price 100–5000 => 'results-heading' updates to '12 results'. Auth split-screen /login shows left hero panel + logo + tagline in navy/red and right form. Unverified freshly-registered user is correctly redirected from /marketplace to /verification; /api/marketplace/summary returns 403.

ui_bugs.issue: The category tile images render as tiny ~20px thumbnails positioned inline next to the label text instead of filling the tile as a background/hero image (see screenshot iter16_marketplace.png). Images DO load (unsplash URLs, imgOk=true) and the placeholder for Jobs works, but the .ct-img / .cat-tile CSS appears to be missing display/height rules so is unstyled. Visually the tiles look empty. Not a blocker but breaks the intended 'shop by category with hero image' design.

action_items: Fix CSS for .cat-tile / .ct-img on Marketplace so the tile image renders as a large hero (e.g. .ct-img{display:block;height:140px;position:relative} .ct-img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}) — currently the img has no dimensions so it collapses to intrinsic ~20px next to the label.
critical_code_review_comments: MarketHeader polls /messages/unread-count and /notifications every 12s from a shared component; because it's mounted on every logged-in page it will double-fire when the route also loads its own data. Consider a single hook or context provider to dedupe.

backend/server.py line 1278 uses a case-insensitive '^test_' regex to exclude titles — matches 'test_' but also legitimately-authored titles starting with 'Test_' etc. Consider explicit '^TEST_' (case-sensitive) or a dedicated is_test_seed flag on the listing document for cleaner separation.
MarketHeader.jsx: profile info is fetched via api.get('/profile/me') on every mount of any page. Move to a top-level React context/AuthContext to avoid N duplicate requests during navigation.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (1 medium CSS bug on category tile images)

rca of the issue: Shop-by-Category tile images render inline as tiny thumbnails because the CSS classes .cat-tile / .ct-img have no explicit width/height on the image element. The JSX outputs and relies on CSS for sizing. In the current build the .ct-img rule appears to be missing (or overridden), so the takes its intrinsic 0x0 -> 20px baseline size and sits next to .ct-label instead of becoming a hero background. Fix: add .ct-img{display:block;width:100%;height:140px;overflow:hidden} .ct-img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block} to App.css and ensure .cat-tile lays label/count below (flex-direction:column). No backend or JS change needed.
